contribution_requirements: Commit message: feat(product): implement investor question 3 - why Kelza is different. Work on feat/kelza-platform-foundation branch.
key_patterns: BEM CSS naming (block__element--modifier). Sections hidden by default with aria-hidden=true, revealed via class toggle (.section--visible). IntersectionObserver for progressive child reveals using [data-reveal] attributes and __element--revealed class. JS controllers export class with reveal()/hide()/destroy() pattern. Dark theme with CSS custom properties from variables.css. Mobile-first responsive with breakpoints at 640px, 768px, 1024px. Reduced motion: transitions disabled, content visible immediately.
directory_structure: Root: index.html, vite.config.js, package.json. css/: main.css imports all other CSS modules. js/: app.js entry point, sections/ for section controllers, engine/ for core engine, effects/ for visual effects. assets/, public/, data/, docs/ for static content.
